messages.ko: 하잉! 요즘 너무너무 감사하게도 바쁜 하루하루를 보내는중이야 연습도있고! 여러가지로 열심히 하고있어!! 이번에 멜뮤시상식 나가는거 들었지!! 영광스럽게도 출연하게되었는데 그 누구보다 열심히 준비할테니까 기대해주고 친친라디오도 나가게 됐거등~~ 앞으로 기대해줄거 응원해줄거 많으니까 마음의 준비하라고 보내는 오랜만의 장문이야 ㅎ내일도 바쁘고 알찬하루를 보낼예정이지만 ..!
messages.en: Hii! I'm so grateful to be so busy these days, I've got practice and all sorts of things! I'm working really hard in many ways!! You heard that I'll be going to the Melon Music Awards this time!! I'm honored to be appearing, so I'll prepare harder than anyone else, please look forward to it. I'm also going to be on ChinChin Radio~~ There are so many things to look forward to and cheer for in the future, so to get you ready, this is a long message I'm sending after a long timeㅎ Tomorrow too, I'm planning to have another busy, fulfilling day..!
In the middle of all this, I miss you 🥹
I want to talk to you.
But I might not wake up on time tomorrow.
So I'll stop here and try to sleep…
